#Dogecoin is down roughly 55% from the all-time high that it hit earlier this month after #Tesla CEO @elonmusk's performance hosting Saturday Night Live. A painful lesson to new cryptocurrency investors: like other financial markets, #crypto are really sensitive to the news.
